card.name: Mixed words before a sector or drug name
card.fires_on: Fires on assorted short words, like 'private', 'can', 'of' and 'in', and on a capital R that starts a drug name in an interaction list. No single shared word category stands out.

modes.label: R starting a drug name
modes.description: The letter R that begins a drug name such as ropinirole, rizatriptan, ritonavir or risperidone in an interaction list.

modes.label: Linking word in general text
modes.description: A short word such as 'of', 'in', 'can' or 'very' in the middle of a general web sentence.
modes.example: On OnLamp you<< can>> find articles about Linux, BSD

modes.description: The word 'private' before a noun such as installations or sector.

card.writes: It slightly favors words meaning reasonable or accumulation and suppresses the word 'means', with no coherent overall effect.
card.plain: It has no single clear trigger; it responds to a mix of unrelated short words and to the first letter R of some drug names.
